sources.why: Colour: MakeHuman system assets (CC0, makehuman_system_assets_cc0.zip sha256 b542127a...0107), mean linear colour of the region in its texture; the texture bakes in some shading (teeth.png, the red gum islands). Coat 0.5 at 0.1, IOR 1.336: saliva. Scatter as skin (Physically Based Skin I-III's radius, anisotropy 0.8, `subsurface_color` = the albedo), since mucosa and sclera are soft tissue of the same kind; no measured radius exists for them.
